content: Hiskia a etiwa ekewe chon künö seni Papilon
Lon ena fansoun ewe kingen Papilon itan Merotak Palatan nöün Palatan we a rong pwe Hiskia a samau o pöchökülsefäl. Iwe, a tinala chon künö, pwe repwe uwala ren nöün toropwe me an lifang.

Iwe, Hiskia a etiweer fän pwapwa o aküna ngeniir an imwen iseis wöün, an silifer me kolt, an nofitin mongö me epit mi aüchea. A pwal aküna ngeniir unusen an imwen pisekin maun me meinisin mine a nom lon an kewe imwen iseis. Esap fokun wor och mettoch lon imwan ika lon mwün esap aküna ngeniir.
Mürin, ewe soufos Aisea a feito ren ewe king Hiskia o aisini, “Met ekewe mwän ra apasa? Ia ra feito me ie?” Nge Hiskia a pälüeni, “Ra feito seni Papilon ewe fanü mi toau.”
Iwe, Aisea a pwal aisini, “Met ra küna me lon imwom?” Hiskia a pälüeni, “Ra küna meinisin mine a nom lon imwei. Esap fokun wor och mettoch lon ai kewe imwen iseis üsap aküna ngeniir.”
Mürin, Aisea a üreni Hiskia, “Kopwe rongorong alon ewe Samol mi Unusen Manaman:
Lon kan fansoun repwe feito epwe fis pwe aramas repwe uwala lon ewe fanü Papilon meinisin mine a nom lon imwom, pwal mine om kewe lewo ra ionifengeni tori ikenai. Resap fokun likiti och.
Repwe pwal uwala ekoch lein noum kewe mwän mi upu ngonuk pwe repwe chon angang lon imwen ewe kingen Papilon.”
Iwe, Hiskia a üreni Aisea, “A öch alon ewe Samol mi Lapalap ka üreniei.” Pun Hesekia a ekieki pwe epwe chök wor kinamwe me mwüöch lon ränin manauan.
